propositions: A rejected auto-push fails silently, leaving diverged local commits while the write still succeeds and reports success to the caller.
The rejection reason is captured by the git process but discarded inside push.py before the only stderr-bearing log call, so the caller sees only a retry count.
The PUSH_PENDING divergence signal is computed only at the read-only fsck path, never consulted by any write path, so a growing unpushed backlog is not re-announced across multiple writes.
Ticket event payloads (comments with pasted environment output) are never scanned for secrets on write, unlike code which passes through the gitleaks gate.
On sync.push=async or library use, the push warning is undeliverable: either discarded to /dev/null or never reaches the calling agent.
